Callout.Name: Rural Burglary
Callout.Message: Farmhouse broken into while the owners were out.
Callout.Advisory: Rear door forced, suspects gone, owners returning.

Script.Line: The back door was put in and they took the guns and the silver.
We were away three days. That was the window.
Do not touch the back door. I want that photographed properly.

Lines.Approach: They came in through the back and they are gone. The owners are on their way home.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
